key_insight: Combining Knowledge Graphs with Large Language Models creates a structured bridge between domain data and ML outputs, producing clear, domain-aware explanations that make manufacturing ML models more interpretable and actionable.
problem_solved: Addresses the gap between opaque ML outputs and domain expert needs in manufacturing by providing transparent, context-rich explanations that tie model results back to domain knowledge.
method: Store domain-specific data, ML predictions, and explanation artifacts in a Knowledge Graph to create explicit links between concepts, features, and outcomes.
Use Large Language Models to generate and refine natural-language explanations and to translate KG relationships into user-friendly narratives and queries.
Expose explanations through a user-facing selection interface (retrieval + LLM synthesis) so practitioners can explore causes, evidence, and suggested actions.
impact: Enables engineers and stakeholders to trust, validate, and act on ML outputs faster by providing contextualized, explainable insights—improving debugging, maintenance, and decision-making in manufacturing.

paper_title: Using Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs to Improve the Interpretability of Machine Learning Models in Manufacturing
paper_authors: Thomas Bayer, Alexander Lohr, Sarah Weiß, Bernd Michelberger, Wolfram Höpken
